values: ¹⁷⁷Lu-PSMA RPT Outcome Framework — Suggested Revisions
Candidate data-element specification supporting the JNM Perspective. It is not a validated core outcome set.
Outcomes are separated from predictors/covariates, treatment exposures, decision variables, and technical metadata.

Use repeated patient-, cycle-, organ-, and lesion-level records; 
capture assessment timing, provenance, method, uncertainty, and missingness.
